err_no_preset: No such provider preset (was the extension that offers it turned off or uninstalled?)
err_chat_protocol_change: This Chat Completions provider cannot be changed to another protocol. Use a client that supports Chat Completions or add a separate provider.
err_chat_launch_settings: Chat Completions providers do not support environment variables, timeout, context limits, default effort, tier models, or subagent settings. Clear these fields to save.
err_api_transport: Direct API providers do not support custom headers, proxy, or no_proxy. Clear these fields to continue.
err_chat_transport: Chat Completions providers do not support custom headers, proxy, or no_proxy. Clear these fields to continue.
err_chat_launcher: Chat Completions connections cannot run as launchers
err_claude_messages: Claude launchers only support Messages connections
err_key_value_or_reference: Give a key or a reference, not both
err_api_launch_fields: A direct API connection can’t have launch arguments, a small model or a subagent model
err_custom_model_name: A custom model’s description needs a name
err_name: Names can only use letters, digits, _ and -, and start with a letter or _ (not “claude”)
err_display_name: The display name can be at most 64 characters, with no line breaks or other control characters
err_assign: assign takes only assistant or agent.new, not {purpose}
err_base_url: Base URL must start with http:// or https://
err_base_url_parts: Base URL can’t contain a user, credentials, a query or a fragment. Put credentials in API Key
err_not_managed: Only launchers added in Persona can be changed here. Change ones in ~/.zshrc on that computer
err_in_use: This provider is still used by {uses}. Switch them in Model config first
err_node_outdated: The personad on this machine is too old to list models. Redeploy it
err_no_models: This provider has no models to list
err_api_no_models: A direct API connection has no models to list
err_all_offline: No computer with this launcher is online, so its models can’t be listed
no_gateway: This launcher has no gateway address (it uses the default official API)
quota_node_outdated: The node on {name} is too old. Update it to check usage limits
err_effort_model: Thinking effort {effort} of model {model} isn’t supported (use {levels})
err_effort_model_default: Default thinking effort {effort} of model {model} isn’t supported (use {levels})
err_env_line: Environment line {line} must be NAME=value, NAME made of letters, digits and _
err_model_no_id: A model in the list has no ID
err_model_context_negative: The context window of model {model} can’t be negative
err_model_effort_empty: Model {model} has an empty thinking effort
err_model_default_effort_unlisted: The default thinking effort of model {model} isn’t one it supports
err_proxy: Proxy must start with http(s):// or socks5://
err_proxy_credentials: Proxy can't carry a username or password
err_tier_model_long: A tier model name is too long
err_builtin_hide: The built-in claude is every machine's default launcher and cannot be hidden
err_scope_none: {provider} stays with the hub: no computer gets its key. Change its Devices in Settings › Model providers, or pick another provider
err_scope_machine: {provider} is not set up for {machine}. Add this computer to its Devices in Settings › Model providers, or pick another provider
err_scope_work: {machine} is a work computer: {provider} reaches it only when it is chosen in the provider's Devices (Settings › Model providers)
err_own_service: {machine} already has its own {harness} service, and {provider} skips such computers. Turn on “Also use on computers with their own sign-in” in its Devices, or pick another provider
err_pull_unknown: {provider} is no longer a model provider in Persona
err_share: Devices must be all, selected or none
err_delivery: Delivery must be on_demand or push
err_own_service_value: own_service must be skip or use
err_scope_empty: Choose at least one computer for this provider
err_scope_unknown_machine: {machine} is not one of your computers
